To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) ETS has a small effect on the risk of radion-induced lung cancer in homes with very high particle concentrations; 2) ETS reduces the risk of radium-induced lung cancer in most homes with moderate particle concentrations; and 3) ETS increases the risk of radum-induced lung cancer in some homes with low particle concentrations.
